title: Ave virgo gloriosa (Joannis Richafort) (Richafort)
desc: Jean Richafort, Ave virgo gloriosa (Joannis Richafort). 3 voices (Superius, Altus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Joannis Richafort. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
